note: KDWP state fishing lake (24 acres in a 190-acre wooded area) on K-99, 5 miles north of Westmoreland. Primitive campsites on the north and west sides off gravel loops, 14 picnic tables in the camping area; two boat ramps, seven gravel fishing piers, a floating dock and a short hiking trail. Off-road vehicles prohibited; the 166 acres around the lake are open to hunting. --Claude
